entityName: Project-S Space and Beyond Technologies UG (haftungsbeschränkt)
entityDescription:
Project-S is a fast-growing space-tech venture dedicated to preserving orbital safety by tackling the escalating issue of space debris. Through a uniquely integrated solution, we offer precision debris detection, proactive collision avoidance, and on-orbit removal capabilities. Our approach leverages:
- Microwave-Based Radar
- Enables high-resolution tracking of debris as small as 1 cm
- Robust under low-visibility or nighttime conditions

- AI-Driven Collision Avoidance
- Proprietary algorithms for real-time trajectory analysis
- Automated risk assessment and advanced warning to satellite operators

- Adaptive Debris Removal
- Modular robotic-based target detumbling
- Swift, cost-effective capture of defunct satellites or hazardous debris

Using a lean deployment strategy, Project-S can protect satellites in specific orbits without requiring a full-scale constellation from the outset. This means quicker time-to-market, reduced upfront costs, and immediate risk mitigation for mission-critical spacecraft. Our end-to-end service aligns with evolving ESA regulations (including Zero Debris guidelines), helping customers meet deorbiting requirements and avoid licensing complications.

description: EOB Space Oy is a Finland-based Earth Observation and AI company developing satellite-data-driven intelligence solutions for environmental monitoring, infrastructure resilience and operational decision support. description: Pole Star EAM Ltd is a UK-based infrastructure asset management software company with over 20 years of experience delivering digital inspection and asset management solutions for major infrastructure operators including Network Rail. entityName: UNIVERSITÀ CATTOLICA DEL SACRO CUOR - Department of Sustainable Crop Production
entityDescription:
The Department of Sustainable Crop Production (DI.PRO.VE.S.) is organized into three thematic research areas, or sections, each with its own specific characteristics but closely interconnected to promote an integrated and multidisciplinary approach. These three areas are: Agronomy and Plant Biotechnology, Fruit Growing and Viticulture, and Sustainable Plant and Food Protection. Each section focuses on different aspects of crop production and protection, contributing complementarily to the scientific and practical advancement of the department.
In addition to these main sectors, the department also includes two highly specialized research centers: the “Research Centre on Biodiversity and Ancient DNA” (BioDNA), which focuses on advanced studies of genetic diversity and ancient DNA analysis, and the “Research Centre for Geospatial Analysis and Remote Sensing” (CRAST), which employs advanced technologies to monitor and analyze crops and plant ecosystems.

entityDescription:
Founded in Milan by Father Agostino Gemelli, Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore is Europe's most important Catholic university.

Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore (UCSC) was established in 1924 and currently consists of four campuses (Milan, Rome, Piacenza-Cremona and Brescia). UCSC operates in both the humanities and sciences with 45 bachelor degree programmes, 6 intensive-study degree programmes, 53 schools of specialization, and almost 100 master degree programmes. Research activity draws on 1310 tenured researchers, 38 institutes, 28 departments, 89 research centres, 7 university centres, 10 research areas and 7 spin-offs and is aimed towards the study and understanding of crucial issues of life and society: new frontiers in economics and bioethics, changes in the field of law, family and cultural trends, mass media, changes in political systems, aims and goals of medicine, technological applications of mathematics and physics, and the most recent discoveries in environmental research.

Backed by 25 years of engineering leadership in aerospace, telecommunications, and mission-critical embedded hardware, blueconnect.ai is a Swiss deep-tech company based in Geneva, specializing in resilient communications, microelectronics, and edge computing for autonomous aerospace (satellites, UAVs, aircrafts) and terrestrial systems.
The entity leverages deep, hands-on flight heritage in SpaceWire and space data-handling technologies, with proven expertise covering the end-to-end design, implementation, and qualification of SpaceWire IP cores and Ground Support Equipment (EGSE). Core competencies include ECSS-compliant (ECSS-E-ST-50-12C / ECSS-E-ST-50-52C) SpaceWire CODEC and Router architectures, RMAP protocol implementations, high-speed USB/Ethernet-to-SpaceWire bridges, and system validation aligned with ESTEC conformance testing frameworks.
Building on this foundation of space-grade reliability and low-power FPGA/SoC design, blueconnect.ai develops next-generation architectures combining RISC-V, on-board Edge-AI acceleration, and connectionless MANET protocols. We deliver deterministic, decentralized control (DMPC) and collaborative Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) solutions for GNSS-denied environments—spanning both in-orbit payload data handling and resilient multi-agent robotic swarms.

JALUD Embedded s.r.o. is a Czech technology company developing edge-AI solutions for real-time acoustic situational awareness. Its core technology, Sound Event Detector (SED), uses artificial intelligence to detect, classify and report security-, safety- and environment-related sound events directly at the edge, without the need for continuous audio transmission to the cloud.
The technology can identify events such as gunshots, screams, aggression, glass breaking, mechanical tools, vehicles, sirens, drones/UAS and other application-specific acoustic signatures. JALUD solutions are designed for deployment in critical infrastructure, public safety, transportation, industrial facilities, environmental monitoring and remote areas.
JALUD specialises in low-power edge AI, acoustic sensing, distributed sensor networks, real-time event detection, sensor integration and situational-awareness systems. Its technology can be integrated with CCTV/VMS platforms, IoT systems, command-and-control environments, GNSS-based positioning and time synchronisation, and satellite or terrestrial communication networks for resilient remote monitoring.
The company develops both embedded software and system-level integrations and has experience with operational deployments, field testing and integration of acoustic intelligence into third-party security and monitoring platforms.

entityDescription:
ANcybernetics is an Italian deep-tech company developing bio-inspired autonomous underwater robotic systems for environmental monitoring, infrastructure inspection and the collection of high-quality subsea data. Founded as an academic spin-off of Università Politecnica delle Marche (UNIVPM), ANcybernetics has been registered in the Italian Special Register of Innovative Start-ups since September 2024.
The company designs and develops compact Biomimetic Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (BAUVs) combining bio-inspired propulsion, autonomous navigation, modular sensor integration and onboard artificial intelligence. Its flagship platform, POSEIDRONE, uses fin-based propulsion inspired by fish locomotion instead of conventional propellers, enabling high manoeuvrability while reducing disturbance to the surrounding environment and seabed.
POSEIDRONE is designed to perform autonomous and repeatable missions and can be deployed directly from shore or from small vessels, reducing the logistical complexity typically associated with underwater robotic operations. Its modular architecture allows the platform to be configured according to the specific mission and data requirements, integrating optical cameras, acoustic sensors, environmental probes and other specialised payloads. Onboard computing and AI enable real-time data processing, perception and the identification of features or anomalies of interest.
ANcybernetics targets applications including the inspection and monitoring of submerged infrastructure, ports, pipelines, cables, reservoirs and coastal assets, as well as seabed mapping, marine habitat monitoring, biodiversity assessment and environmental data collection. The company is developing solutions aimed at making underwater monitoring more autonomous, scalable, repeatable and accessible, while reducing human exposure to hazardous underwater operations.
ANcybernetics develops its core robotic, control and autonomy technologies in-house and is building an ecosystem of specialised sensors, communication systems and industrial partners around its platforms. The company is also exploring the integration of underwater robotics with satellite-enabled services, including satellite navigation, Earth Observation and satellite communications, to support georeferenced surveys, remote operations and integrated monitoring of maritime, coastal and water-related assets.
Through its combination of robotics, AI, bio-inspired engineering and environmental sensing, ANcybernetics aims to bridge the gap between traditional remotely operated vehicles and large, complex autonomous underwater systems, enabling a new generation of flexible and cost-effective subsea monitoring services.

Martinr B.V. is a Netherlands-based micro-enterprise specialising in front-end development and user interface design for space engineering, Earth observation, human spaceflight and civil protection.
Core capabilities: front-end web application development in TypeScript, user experience design for complex technical and scientific data, interactive data visualisation and dashboards, design systems and accessibility, and real-time and interactive web applications. Technologies include TypeScript, React, WebRTC, WebGL and mapping libraries, and REST/OpenAPI integration.
The company draws on four years of experience delivering software for ESA and related institutional programmes within teams at Starion Group, ATG Europe and Space Applications Services. This work included review interfaces for ECSS-E-TM-10-25 models in support of model-based systems engineering (UI-DSM), an ESA Earth Observation mission database supporting capability mapping and long-term planning (EORSA-DB), a live meeting tool used during Axiom Mission 4 to connect the ISS crew with audiences on Earth, and the PPRD Med disaster prevention and response platform. This provides working familiarity with ECSS standards, MBSE tooling and ESA review processes.
Martinr B.V. is available to ESA and to prime contractors as a subcontractor or consortium partner for front-end development, UI/UX design, data visualisation and interactive web applications.

Impact Ninja is a specialised Poland-based consultancy and expert firm focused on social impact evaluation, evidence-based assessment, and narrative modeling for research, technology, and innovation.Founded and led by Dr. Marta Wróblewska—a leading European expert on impact assessment with a PhD from the University of Warwick—the firm integrates academic rigor with practical policy experience. Dr. Wróblewska brings extensive experience from the public agency sector, having served in operational and strategic roles at the National Centre for Research and Development (NCBR) in Poland, where she also chaired expert evaluation panels. Her research has been supported by major competitive research grants (including the Volkswagen Stiftung and NCN) and active membership in the Research on Research Institute (RoRI) at University College London (UCL). She is author of a PhD Thesis, a practical ebooks and several academic papers dedicated to research impact evaluation policies and related institutional change.

entityDescription: Klimaforge AS is a Norwegian company building satellite-based evidence infrastructure for EU forest regulation and forest-carbon markets. Its EUDR compliance engine turns Copernicus Sentinel-1/2 change detection into audit-ready compliance verdicts by cross-checking flagged forest clearings against independent government land registries — live today in Norway and Germany — rather than relying on supplier-submitted paperwork. A parallel above-ground biomass platform, using satellite radar, optical and spaceborne LiDAR data, extends the same detection core into forest-carbon measurement, reporting and verification (MRV), delivered nationally in Estonia and piloted in Norway. Klimaforge is downstream of ESA's Earth Observation systems (Copernicus Sentinel-1/2, NASA GEDI, ALOS PALSAR-2) and is preparing to launch commercially in Norway from January 2027.

entityDescription:
Comex BV helps organizations maintain control over their most critical data.
We provide secure, European storage solutions for backup, archiving, and AI workloads, with full control as the foundation for digital sovereignty. As the exclusive distributor of FAST LTA in the Benelux, we offer storage designed for certainty: scalable, efficient, and legally protected within Europe—whether on-premises, hybrid, or as part of a broader data strategy.

From tape to the future. Comex helps organizations build true digital control.

entityDescription: Vordh AS is a Norwegian start-up that builds a satellite connected sensing grid for places that cannot be fenced, such as land borders, coasts, the Arctic, airports and remote energy sites. Small, sealed, battery powered acoustic nodes detect and classify drones, vehicles, gunshots and movement on the node, locate events together over a mesh, and report over 5G and other NTN protocols through direct to device satellite links where there is no cellular network. The solution is for detection and situational awareness only. Vordh is a downstream user of satellite communication and satellite navigation and applies to ESA BIC Norway.
